items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is Artin-Rees for a coherent sheaf on a Noetherian algebraic space with a quasi-coherent subsheaf and a sheaf of ideals, asserting the existence of a constant past which the two intersections agree (statement lines 2361-2374). The proof reduces to an affine Noetherian scheme etale over the space, observes that the equality is detected after restriction, and quotes the scheme case. The reduction and the locality check are the substance, so the claim is H2.
